'''Jason Foss Hunt Down with dueling''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jason Foss]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9675">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9675 Hunt Down with dueling], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 20 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9675/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9675/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018132514/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9675/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Foss]]
* '''Published:''' 20 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hunt Down with dueling''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}

* '''Strategy:''' This is a very high destiny hunt down deck that uses epic duel.

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down with dueling'''
* '''Author:''' Jason "jade" Foss
* '''Published:''' August 20, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is a very high destiny hunt down deck that uses epic duel.

=== Strategy ===

First of i would just like to say that huntdown is not dead despite honor giving it a blo To the face.Im telling you that huntdown with dueling ruled the tournament i go to because nobody expects it so they take out there anti dueling cards.

This is the first huntdown deck i'v made and i think it's pretty good basicaly get out the docking bays deploy vader at one mara at one and emporer at the other so you activat tons of force Get sim aloo and janus out so you can be sure that you wont lose before you duel.
